<Subject 1>：同一位中国黄土高原山区老年男性，灰白短发、花白胡须、深刻皱纹、深蓝黑色旧棉衣、灰褐色围巾。人物面孔、年龄、胡须、发型和服装始终一致。

<Picture 1>：0.00秒真实首帧。老人站在黄土窑洞前，右手抓围巾，仰头望向远方。

<Picture 2>：8.20秒强制关键帧。老人坐在山坡上，双臂搭在膝盖上，侧脸望向辽阔山谷。完整保留蜿蜒山路、山岭、荒草和阴天天空。

summary:

20秒写实电影情绪短片。老人从头到尾保持明显、连续、真实的张嘴讲话动作。7.85–8.20秒通过快速向右甩镜自然过渡到第二张图。8.20秒第二张图必须完整出现，老人从出现的第一帧开始明显张嘴，之后持续到19秒。最后1秒镜头向右转为山谷无人空镜。

最高优先级：人物只要在画面中，嘴巴就必须持续进行大幅度、自然流畅的讲话口型变化。不能中途停止，不能长时间闭嘴，不能只动表情而不动嘴。

retention_analysis:

<Subject 1>：fully_preserved — 完整保留两张图片中人物的面孔、胡须、头发及服装。面部表情与口腔、下颌允许真实、明显的讲话动作。

<Picture 1>：fully_preserved — 保留0秒首帧与窑洞背景。

<Picture 2>：fully_preserved — 8.20秒完整呈现第二张图片，保留人物坐姿、侧脸轮廓、山谷与道路。必须将静态参考图中的嘴部转化为持续活跃的讲话状态。

detailed_description:

全局口型运动规则（适用于所有人物可见画面）：

老人始终处于激烈程度适中、情感深沉的连续讲话状态，嘴唇不断张开、闭合、圆唇、展唇，张嘴时能够明显看到口腔内部暗部和少量牙齿，下颌有清晰的上下运动，双颊和胡须真实联动。

平均每0.5–0.8秒完成一次明显的口型开合变化，其中每次张口持续约0.25–0.45秒。闭口仅用于瞬间衔接下一次发音动作，连续紧闭不得超过0.15秒。

口型必须有真实的动态变化，不能一直保持固定张嘴，也不能连续数秒闭嘴。人物情绪变化不能替代口型运动。

所有人物可见镜头中，口型动作具有最高动作优先级。

[Shot 1] 0.00–7.85s｜窑洞前深沉诉说

0秒从第一张参考图开始，老人位于画面右侧，仰头望向远方，右手紧握胸前围巾。

0.00–2.00秒：老人立即开始明显地反复张嘴讲话，口腔内部清晰可见，下颌上下运动，嘴角自然变化。眉头轻微皱起，眼神深沉。

2.00–4.00秒：老人持续张嘴讲话，嘴唇不断开合，面部皱纹随着讲话自然牵动。眼眶逐渐湿润，表情带有压抑的悲伤。镜头缓慢推进，强化嘴部及眼神细节。

4.00–6.00秒：老人仍不停做明显的讲话口型，每次张嘴都有真实的下颌运动。嘴角偶尔轻微颤抖，眉头紧锁，眼神仿佛沉浸于往事。

6.00–7.85秒：老人缓慢降低目光，稍微松开围巾，嘴巴依然持续大幅度自然开合。直到甩镜开始前的最后一帧，仍能看到清晰的讲话动作。

[Transition] 7.85–8.20s｜快速甩镜转场

7.85秒摄影机快速向右水平甩动，窑洞、老人和黄土山体形成真实的方向性运动模糊。

8.00秒在运动模糊最强处完成隐藏式场景匹配切换。

8.00–8.20秒镜头快速减速，运动模糊散去，第二张参考图片中的老人和山谷立即呈现。

8.20秒第二张图必须完整、清晰出现。

转场总长0.35秒，不使用黑屏、闪白、慢速溶解、变形或长时间遮挡。

[Shot 2] 8.20–19.00s｜山谷前连续张嘴诉说

8.20秒，完整展示第二张参考图。

老人坐在画面右侧山坡上，双臂放在膝盖上，身体略微前倾，侧脸望向左侧辽阔山谷。

第二张图出现的第一帧，老人嘴巴必须已经明显张开，绝不能以闭嘴静止状态开始。

8.20–10.00秒：老人立刻连续做明显张嘴讲话动作。嘴唇反复张开闭合，张口时可看见口腔内部和少量牙齿，嘴角、下颌、胡须同步运动。至少出现两次以上清晰的大幅度口型变化。眼神沉重，眉头紧皱。镜头保持原图构图，确保侧脸嘴部可见。

10.00–12.00秒：老人继续不断张嘴讲话，不得暂停。下巴随着发音节奏上下运动，双唇持续变化，嘴巴多次明显张开。眼眶略微湿润，目光凝视远处山路。即使眼神和眉头变化，嘴巴仍必须保持活跃运动。

12.00–14.00秒：老人仍然连续张嘴讲话，发音口型有明显大小变化，嘴巴张开时可见口腔暗部。老人稍微抬高下巴，目光从山路移向远方山脊。嘴角略微颤抖，情绪深沉克制。禁止出现持续闭嘴凝视的静态画面。

14.00–16.00秒：嘴巴持续自然开合，下颌规律运动，胡须与脸颊跟随变化。老人眉头逐渐舒展，眼眶湿润，表达对往事的沉思。镜头轻微向右横移，人物侧脸始终清晰，嘴部动作仍是视觉重点。

16.00–18.00秒：老人仍在持续明显地张嘴讲话，不能停止口型。每0.5–0.8秒出现新的嘴部开合动作。目光变得平静，表情逐渐释然。摄影机缓慢向右移动并轻微右摇，老人逐渐从画面右侧移动至左侧，露出更多山谷。

18.00–19.00秒：老人保持连续张嘴讲话动作，口腔和下颌仍清晰活动。摄影机继续向右，老人逐渐靠近画面左边缘。嘴部运动不得提前停止，也不能提前让人物消失。

强制要求：8.20–19.00秒期间，第二张图的场景必须持续存在，老人必须始终保持明显、连贯、持续的张嘴说话动作。任何时间段不得变为静态闭嘴人物。

[Shot 3] 19.00–20.00s｜向右转空镜

19.00秒，镜头顺势加快向右横移与右摇。

19.00–19.40秒：老人仍在持续张嘴讲话，直到人物从画面左侧完全退出。

19.40–20.00秒：画面变为纯粹的无人山谷空镜，保留蜿蜒道路、层叠黄土山岭、枯草与灰蓝色天空。

镜头减速并稳定，最终一帧不出现人物。

overall_soundscape:

自然山风、轻微衣物摩擦和真实环境声。人物持续做无声讲话口型，不生成具体台词、不出现可辨认人声和字幕。8秒转场时风声保持连续，最后以山谷风声结束。

non_diegetic_music:

低沉的大提琴、稀疏钢琴，节奏缓慢。前段压抑沉重，第二段逐渐转为深沉释然。甩镜时音乐无缝衔接，19秒开始淡出。

subject_definitions:

<Picture 1> is the uploaded three-view character design sheet of the silver-haired chibi anime boy.

<Subject 1> is one single front-facing instance of the exact silver-haired anime boy from <Picture 1>, featuring fluffy layered silver-white hair, soft brown eyes, delicate youthful anime facial proportions, subtle blush, an oversized black hooded jacket, silver necklace, black cargo trousers and black-white sneakers.

summary:

Create a single continuous 8.100-second anime digital-human explainer in 16:9 widescreen.

The silver-haired anime boy remains permanently anchored on the far left side of the frame, performing clearly visible and continuous silent lip articulation according to the exact timing of five Mandarin sentences.

The center and right side deliver a powerful visual explanation of four concepts: "15秒", "几分钟", "4K" and "30秒".

The entire presentation uses aggressive crimson-black-ivory grunge motion graphics, enormous black dry-brush strokes, explosive crimson paint, distressed screen-print typography, torn-paper textures, scratched ink surfaces and dramatic asymmetric graphic composition.

The video has absolutely no audible dialogue, no sound effects and no background music.

retention_analysis:

CHARACTER IDENTITY:

Preserve <Subject 1> exactly.

Maintain his original clean Japanese anime illustration style, fluffy silver-white hairstyle, brown eyes, facial proportions, soft skin shading, subtle blush, black oversized hooded jacket, silver necklace and clothing details.

Do not change the character's art style, hairstyle, facial structure, clothing, proportions or colors.

The original image contains front, side and rear character views, but the final video displays ONLY ONE front-facing anime boy.

Do not reproduce the three-view character sheet in the video.

STRICT LEFT-SIDE COMPOSITION:

The boy stays permanently on the FAR LEFT SIDE.

His body occupies approximately 25% to 28% of the total frame width.

His character is positioned within the leftmost 30% of the 16:9 composition.

Show the boy from the chest upward or waist upward in a stable front-facing medium shot.

His face must be sufficiently large for clearly visible lip movements.

The center and right 65% to 70% of the screen are reserved for large distressed typography, ink animation, duration graphics, image-quality demonstrations and digital-human video illustrations.

Never place the boy in the center.

Never move the character to the right.

Never zoom into a centered talking-head shot.

Keep the camera composition stable while the surrounding graphics transform.

All large brushstrokes and typography must remain behind or beside the boy, never obscuring his face.

MANDATORY VISIBLE SILENT LIP ARTICULATION:

The boy's mouth movement is a primary continuous visual action.

During every speaking interval, his mouth must repeatedly move through clearly distinguishable anime articulation shapes: closed lips, narrow opening, wider vertical opening, rounded lips and natural partial closure.

The mouth and lower jaw move visibly in a natural Mandarin-speaking rhythm.

Lip articulation continues even when the surrounding graphic animation is fast or visually intense.

Never allow the boy's mouth to remain frozen during an active speaking interval.

At specified pauses, the mouth closes naturally and remains still.

Only the lips and lower jaw move noticeably. The character may blink subtly, but the head, torso and arms remain nearly motionless.

The mouth movement is entirely silent.

detailed_description:

OVERALL VISUAL STYLE:

High-impact experimental grunge editorial animation.

Massive rough black dry-brush strokes, saturated crimson red paint, warm ivory paper textures, irregular ink erosion, distressed screen-printing, torn-paper edges, gritty halftone grain, scratched black surfaces and explosive painted transitions.

Graphic motion feels forceful, physical, raw and handmade.

Large painted objects transform into new visual objects instead of disappearing and being replaced by unrelated graphics.

The overall design maintains a consistent crimson-black-ivory visual identity while changing layout, scale, material exposure and color dominance between shots.

The anime boy remains cleanly illustrated and separated from the surrounding rough graphic textures.

[Shot 1]

00:00.000–00:01.767:

A saturated crimson background fills the frame.

A huge irregular black dry-brush stroke tears diagonally across the center-right, revealing warm ivory textured paper beneath the paint.

The silver-haired anime boy is already visible on the far left, front-facing, maintaining exactly the same character design and clean illustration style.

He immediately begins clearly visible silent mouth articulation.

On the right, an enormous rough printed title reading "15秒" bursts out of the scraped black paint.

The lettering is heavy, dramatic and distressed, with broken ink edges and scratched texture.

The number "15" dominates the right side while the character "秒" emerges through a wide crimson brushstroke.

Behind the typography, a short filmstrip-like graphic unfolds from beneath layers of scratched ink.

The filmstrip contains abstract digital-human video imagery and simple mouth-shape illustrations, without introducing any additional full human character.

A rough black painted frame forms around the filmstrip.

Small crimson ink fragments react around the large title while the composition maintains strong negative space.

The boy's mouth continues opening, narrowing, rounding and closing in repeated natural articulation throughout the entire 00:00.000–00:01.767 interval.

00:01.767–00:01.800:

The boy briefly closes his mouth.

A thick crimson paint stroke begins moving from the "15秒" graphic toward the right edge.

[Shot 2] At 00:01.800,

00:01.800–00:03.434:

The boy immediately resumes clearly visible silent mouth articulation.

The thick crimson brushstroke violently sweeps across the right-side composition.

It pushes the "15秒" typography backward and partially scrapes it away.

The moving paint transforms into massive distressed Chinese typography reading "几分钟".

The lettering enters with a sharp graphic collision, producing rough black printed fragments and scattered crimson ink.

Behind the title, a long black painted duration track extends rapidly across the right side.

Multiple rough timing marks appear along the track.

The entire duration track suddenly begins compressing inward.

A giant crimson brushstroke drives the compression, forcing the timing marks closer together.

The long painted timeline collapses into a short, compact graphic strip.

A rough circular black ink mechanism rotates quickly around the compressed duration strip.

The circular mechanism tightens into a bold painted stamp, visually emphasizing a fast completion process.

The crimson painted area temporarily expands across most of the center-right background.

The oversized title "几分钟" remains clearly readable.

The boy stays completely fixed on the far left, with his lips visibly articulating throughout 00:01.800–00:03.434.

The compact painted duration strip becomes the carrier for the following transition.

[Shot 3] At 00:03.434,

00:03.434–00:05.467:

The boy continues clear silent lip articulation without interruption.

The compressed duration strip expands into a rough black rectangular surface.

A massive crimson dry-brush stroke tears across the rectangle.

The black surface fractures, revealing huge distressed typography reading "4K".

The letters are enormous, with bold rough printed strokes, irregular scratched edges and areas of missing ink.

The background shifts into a high-contrast composition of crimson red, black and exposed ivory paper.

The large "4K" title becomes the dominant visual focus on the right.

Behind it, a rough rectangular digital-image panel is scratched open.

The panel initially displays coarse printed halftone patterns and low-detail image textures.

A bold black brushstroke sweeps across the panel, progressively removing the coarse printed texture.

A crisp, sharply detailed anime-style illustration surface is revealed underneath.

Fine outlines, clear color boundaries and detailed textures become increasingly visible.

A crimson paint swipe reveals the supporting title "直出4K".

The rough graphic frame expands slightly around the newly sharpened image.

Small geometric print marks and black ink fragments react around the "4K" title.

This visual sequence communicates high-resolution output through a dramatic material transformation rather than a polished technical interface.

Throughout the interval, the boy remains on the far left, continuously moving his lips with noticeable closed, open and rounded mouth shapes.

00:05.467–00:05.500:

The boy briefly closes his mouth.

A giant black diagonal dry-brush stroke begins sweeping across the 4K composition.

[Shot 4] At 00:05.500,

00:05.500–00:07.100:

The boy immediately resumes visible silent lip articulation.

The massive black dry-brush stroke tears the previous graphic layout apart.

The scratched "4K" title breaks into rough ink fragments.

A thick crimson paint band emerges from beneath the black surface and rapidly stretches across the center-right.

The painted band transforms into a long, irregular video-duration strip.

Large painted timing marks appear along the strip.

A massive distressed number "30" slams into the right side.

A rough crimson brushstroke reveals the Chinese character "秒" beside it, completing the title "30秒".

The large title uses heavy uneven screen-printing, scratched black edges and dramatic contrast against warm ivory paper.

The duration strip grows longer beneath the title, visually conveying an increased supported video length.

Small printed timing marks travel along the expanding strip.

A black brushstroke bends around the large "30秒" typography, forming an irregular painted frame.

The crimson paint occupies a large portion of the composition, creating a powerful visual peak.

The boy continues clear silent mouth movements throughout 00:05.500–00:07.100.

The expanding duration strip remains visible and becomes the transition object for the final composition.

[Shot 5] At 00:07.100,

00:07.100–00:08.100:

The boy continues natural, clearly visible silent mouth articulation for the final phrase.

The long crimson duration strip transforms into a wide rough printed video frame.

A black dry-brush stroke sweeps through the video frame, uncovering a stylized digital-human output panel.

Inside the panel, a sequence of three simplified anime mouth-shape illustrations changes rhythmically, communicating a digital-human lip-sync video.

These are graphic mouth symbols only, not additional people or duplicate anime characters.

The large "30秒" title remains visible above the output panel.

A bold crimson brushstroke reveals supporting Chinese typography reading "数字人口播".

The surrounding layout recomposes into a visually striking editorial poster.

The final graphic composition emphasizes the four key ideas through clear visual hierarchy:

"15秒"
"几分钟"
"4K"
"30秒"

The main final hero is "30秒", supported by "数字人口播".

The previous key concepts are retained only as smaller readable graphic stamps, keeping the right-side composition visually balanced rather than overcrowded.

Small black printed fragments and crimson paint marks react briefly, then settle.

The boy remains permanently on the far left, maintaining his exact original silver-white hair, brown eyes, facial features, black outfit and clean anime rendering.

His lips continue opening and closing throughout 00:07.100–00:08.100.

At 00:08.100, his mouth naturally closes.

The final frame holds the silver-haired boy on the far left and the bold crimson-black-ivory graphic result on the right.

GLOBAL VISUAL CONSISTENCY:

The silver-haired anime boy never changes position.

Never center the character.

Never enlarge him into a full-screen portrait.

Only one instance of the original anime boy appears throughout.

Keep his face and mouth clearly visible at all times.

Maintain obvious silent lip articulation during every active speaking interval, including during transitions.

Preserve his clean anime illustration style while the surrounding graphics use rough ink, scratched printing, distressed typography and violent brushstroke transformations.

Each major visual transition is driven by a continuing graphic object:

Black dry-brush stroke to "15秒".
Crimson paint stroke to "几分钟".
Compressed duration strip to "4K".
Black diagonal brushstroke to "30秒".
Expanded video-duration strip to "数字人口播".

Use only the specified short visual keywords:

"15秒"
"几分钟"
"4K"
"直出4K"
"30秒"
"数字人口播"

Do not display full-sentence subtitles.

Avoid corporate presentation layouts, clean floating technology cards, glossy gradients, polished user-interface dashboards, unnecessary tiny lettering and repetitive title-only scenes.

Do not introduce additional speaking characters.

No audible voice, no human vocal sounds and no music.
